hook.text: Good morning. / How do I win this deal (typed into the Ask Attio prompt, then 'Thinking...')

summary.tone: Minimal, confident, monochrome typographic launch teaser: music-led, no voice-over, quiet sentence-case copy alternating light and dark stages.

signature_moments.description: The typed question resolves to a scaling 'Thinking...' label and a black circle that zooms through to a dark stage reading 'Everything creates signal'.
signature_moments.why_premium: The product's own waiting state becomes the transition, so the jump from UI to manifesto feels motivated rather than cut.

signature_moments.description: 'Every email / call / note / web search' with bespoke micro-illustrations, then a scrolling tick-mark ruler streaming data-source labels (records, payments, events, conversations).
signature_moments.why_premium: Each data type gets its own small visual metaphor and the ruler turns an integrations list into a timeline, conveying breadth without logos or screenshots.

signature_moments.description: 'Ask Attio' with a grey suffix that cycles through eight use cases on the beat, collapsing into 'Ask more from CRM.' and the wordmark.
signature_moments.why_premium: A single typographic device carries the whole feature list, keeps rhythm with the music and lands the tagline as wordplay on the product name.

hook.evidence: Opens directly on a product moment (greeting, prompt typed 'How do I win this deal', 'Thinking...') that poses a relatable sales question; no stat or bold claim, and the first seconds are calm rather than arresting.

clarity.evidence: The argument is easy to follow in text alone: everything creates signal, every data source listed, everything is context, Universal Context, then concrete use cases; the product's actual answer UI is never shown, so what the output looks like stays implied.

ui_showcase.evidence: Only s001 shows a simplified recreated UI (prompt box, chips, meetings list); the rest of the video is kinetic type and abstract graphics, with no answer, record or workflow screen.

motion_polish.evidence: Motivated transitions (zoom-through circle, light panel wipe, push), per-noun micro-animations, rising line field and a clean suffix-cycle resolve; at 2 fps I cannot judge easing or frame-level finish, so not scored 5.

sound_design.evidence: Judged from anchors, not listening: a 129.2 BPM music bed at -12.37 integrated LUFS drives the edit, and word swaps land about every 0.5 s, matching the beat spacing; SFX are sparse but placed on key moments (glitch-like impact x001 at the s002 zoom-through, risers x002/x003 in the s003 build, chime-like x004 at the 'Universal Context' reveal in s006); three of four SFX labels are 'unsure' and detected beats stop after 36.76 s.

vo_script_quality.evidence: No voice-over: anchors contain no transcript words.

brand_consistency.evidence: One sans typeface, a strictly monochrome palette, sentence-case copy and alternating light/dark stages throughout, ending on the attio wordmark and URL; the 'Ask Attio' prompt recurs at the start and end.

works_muted.evidence: With no voice-over, every idea is carried by on-screen text and visuals, so the story survives muted; only the beat-locked rhythm and SFX accents are lost.

overall.evidence: A tight 47 s typographic launch teaser with a clear manifesto-to-use-cases arc, strong brand discipline and inventive transitions; held back by almost no real product UI.

localization_friendliness.notes: No voice-over, so no dubbing needed, but the whole story is baked-in English kinetic type (about 120 on-screen words), including the 'Ask Attio ... / Ask more from CRM.' wordplay that will not translate directly; text is simple centred type on flat stages, so re-rendering per locale is straightforward if the source project is available.

pattern.description: The opening frame shows only 'Good morning.' near centre. The whole home layout then glides upward and slightly shrinks together while the prompt input, suggestion chips and meetings list fade in beneath the greeting, so the greeting settles into its place as the page header.
pattern.why_premium: The product opens on a single human line and the UI builds around it in one continuous, eased move, with no cut or pop. The greeting becomes the anchor of the real interface, and the soft fade-and-rise reads calm and native to the product.
